currentParagraphText: “What is it?” Viridia asked, turning to the dragonkin as she wondered if more guests had arrived to try and form good relations with the Order of the Malefic Viper.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “What is it?” Viridia asked, turning to the dragonkin as she wondered if more guests had arrived to try and form good relations with the Order of the Malefic Viper.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I just received a message that the Order will be sending exploratory teams of C and B-grades to enter the Mycotic Depths, and you are to ensure they have spots available,” the assistant spoke curtly.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Excuse me, Hall Master?” one of Viridia’s assistants spoke as he teleported into the room, shaking the Verdant Witch out of her thoughts.
